key.name: overlay-enabled
key.summary: Show the lyric overlay while a song with timed lyrics plays

key.name: font-size
key.summary: Lyric text size in pixels; a line too long for the box shrinks to fit

key.name: font-family
key.summary: Font family; empty means the desktop interface font

key.name: text-color
key.summary: Letter color

key.name: text-border
key.summary: Rings around the letters: black or white, whichever contrasts more with the letter color, then the other

key.name: text-border-scale
key.summary: Ring thickness as a multiple of the standard width for the text size

key.name: text-align
key.summary: Where the lyric sits across its box

key.name: pitch-enabled
key.summary: Show the pitch panel, a trace of the sung pitch from the microphone, while a song plays

key.name: pitch-dock
key.summary: Where the pitch panel sits: against a side of the lyric box, or separate (pitch-box)

key.name: pitch-docked-height
key.summary: Height of the pitch panel docked above or below the lyric, as a fraction of the work area height

key.name: pitch-docked-width
key.summary: Width of the pitch panel docked left or right of the lyric, as a fraction of the work area width

key.name: pitch-box
key.summary: Separate pitch panel center and size as fractions of its monitor's work area

key.name: pitch-box-monitor
key.summary: Monitor index of the separate pitch panel; -1 follows the primary monitor

key.name: pitch-range
key.summary: Notes shown: fixed from pitch-range-bottom to pitch-range-top, or pitch-follow-span semitones following the voice

key.name: pitch-range-bottom
key.summary: Lowest note of the fixed range as a MIDI note number (48 is C3, 60 is middle C)

key.name: pitch-range-top
key.summary: Highest note of the fixed range as a MIDI note number (72 is C5); at least 6 above the bottom

key.name: pitch-follow-span
key.summary: Semitones shown when the range follows the voice

key.name: pitch-window-seconds
key.summary: Seconds of singing across the panel

key.name: pitch-time-in-silence
key.summary: The trace keeps scrolling through silences; off, it stops 0.4 s into a pause

key.name: pitch-line-width
key.summary: Pitch trace thickness in pixels

key.name: pitch-line-color
key.summary: Pitch trace color as #rrggbb

key.name: pitch-background-opacity
key.summary: Opacity of the panel's black background

key.name: pitch-labels
key.summary: Which note lines carry their name; names that would collide give way to scale notes

key.name: pitch-label-size
key.summary: Note name size in pixels

key.name: pitch-scale
key.summary: Scale whose note lines stand out: detected from the song's audio, fixed (pitch-scale-root, pitch-scale-type), or none

key.name: pitch-scale-root
key.summary: Root of the fixed scale as a pitch class (0 is C, 7 is G)

key.name: pitch-scale-type
key.summary: Type of the fixed scale

key.name: pitch-show-key
key.summary: Name the scale in the panel's corner

key.name: pitch-readout
key.summary: Where the current note shows: a column at a side, a corner over the trace, or nowhere

key.name: pitch-readout-size
key.summary: Current note height as a fraction of the panel height

key.name: pitch-readout-cents
key.summary: Show how many cents the voice is off the current note

key.name: pitch-rate
key.summary: Pitch analyses per second

key.name: pitch-microphone
key.summary: PipeWire node name of the microphone; empty means the system's default input

key.name: pitch-echo-cancel
key.summary: Subtract what the speakers play from the microphone, so the trace follows the singer instead of the song

key.name: box
key.summary: Overlay box center and size as fractions of its monitor's work area

key.name: box-monitor
key.summary: Monitor index of the box; -1 follows the primary monitor
